text:
elaine: Heads up — p95 dash render latency regressed. digging shows repeated auth calls per widget in the query fanout. idea: add a 'permission fingerprint' that gateway returns once per fanout; downstreams consult it to skip per-widget policy.

mike: fingerprint = compact bitset + etag + optional parameterized predicate?

elaine: exactly. proto sketch: {etag, mask_hex, predicate, params, strict:false}. downstreams treat it as advisory unless strict=true.

tony: safety first: fingerprint must never expand permissions. runtime rule: apply only when fingerprint is a subset of full_policy. rollout with sampled double-checks (1-5%) to measure divergence.

zara: ops notes: need a batch endpoint: POST /v1/auth/fingerprint/batch. targets: p50 <5ms, p95 <30ms. tenant-level throttles and connection pooling.

frank: telemetry to add: fingerprint.latency_ms, fingerprint.cache_hit_rate, fingerprint.divergence.count, render.saved_ms. alert if divergence >0.1% sustained 1h.

mike: rollout plan: 1) implement service behind flag in audit mode; 2) gateway attaches fingerprint for single-tenant dashboards only; 3) sampled double-checks 5% -> 1%; 4) flip strict when divergence <0.1% for 48h. include kill-switch.

zara: infra sizing: small autoscaling CPU fleet, aggressive keepalives, batch size default 100, cap 500. invalidation hooks on role/seat/resource change.

tony: edge case: shared embeds that reference other tenants. keep those out of phase 1. start with tenant-owned widgets to reduce blast radius.

elaine: owners: elaine (arch), mike (gateway), tony (auth), zara (ops), frank (telemetry). i'll draft an RFC with proto, metrics, and test plan.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary queued for branch "fingerprint-proto" to staging. ETA ~20m.

frank: i'll run synthetic 400-concurrency renders once canary is up and post divergence vs render-fail graphs.

elaine: thanks everyone. RFC draft in the channel later today. :rocket:
